Not one memory, but several overlapping memories flow overlapping through the mist. 

Eliot standing in front of a mirror, a stern expression on his face. Years of over lapping memories Eliot as a small boy with with a mop of dark hair and a black eye and raggy clothes, Eliot dressed in a suit and tie his dark hair cut short,  Eliot in a frilly dress with mint colored hair, Eliot from a week ago disheveled and frightful. The same stern steely look in his eyes through the ages.  All of them muttering an unheard mantra. More memories flash of Eliot in his hometown, using that same mantra as he stands up against bullies, against thieves, against his parents. And once, only once, in the comfort of his own cafe as someone tried to steal from his register. 

As the mist leaves his mouth so to does some of his steel willpower, his use of fear as a utility, his ***intimidation***. Eliot suppresses a shudder as he witness for one last time what he is losing, but its not a part of him he favored, it was something he needed, but hopefully he will never have need of...
